summary: Curated discussion signals: OpenAI/Open-source agent runtime moves, operator pain reports (Cloudflare, Offrun), sandbox/MCP projects, and legal/security pressure on OpenAI. Prioritise OpenAI Dots + legal coverage, AWS persistent-GPU workflow reports, and several emerging runtimes/MCP sandboxes for follow-up. | Vendor-only sweep: product releases (JetBrains, OpenAI, Cloudflare, Cursor), operator guides (AWS, E2B), and infra updates (Modal, Anthropic containment, Daytona). Prioritize product deltas and operator how‑tos; follow up for social/operator reports and adoption metrics. | GitHub-first snapshot: multiple vendor releases (Google Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, Cloudflare Agents) plus several high-star and workflow-focused agent repos; many repo-only signals need social/operator corroboration before promotion. | Package-sourced snapshot: mix of vendor SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic), infra primitives (MCP servers, memory, eval, security), and IDE/sandbox extensions. Lacks social/operator reports for workflow signals.
